assumptions: Only one finite input torque actuator; no equality constraints, ideal clutches or output actuation.
Bearing and pin interiors use hinge joints; exposed flap spine and plates, working teeth and retainers collide.
Nonworking lightening holes and glyph pockets are filled in collision proxies; masses use the saved CAD solids.
Belt and gearbox represented by finite reflected input inertia and torque only, not belt elasticity, tooth skip, motor phases or gearbox backlash.
Coulomb friction, proposed solid densities and spring rates are unmeasured.
Front-corner rounds and screw holes are conservatively filled in fixed collision proxies.
Working CAD outlines use .005 mm native tessellation plus <= 0.005 mm measured planar simplification; holes preserved.
